proved_step: LEMMA (Hall step of Thm 4.1, hypotheses split; status CLAIMED, re-derivation of the owner paper's argument, not new). Setting: K subset F^I with blocks I_v (v in V), G=(V,E), d>=1. Let B=(b_j)_{j in J} be any finite family with span(B)=K. Put N(v)={j in J : b_j|I_v != 0} and N(X)=union of N(v) over v in X. (R): rank pi_X >= d|X| for every nonempty X subset V, where pi_X restricts to the blocks of X. CLAIM A (injection, uses only R and spanning): there is an injection f: V x [d] -> J with f(v,i) in N(v). PROOF A: Fix X. Any j outside N(X) has b_j zero on I_X, so pi_X(b_j)=0. Since B spans K, pi_X(K)=span{pi_X(b_j): j in N(X)}, hence d|X| <= rank pi_X <= |N(X)|. For S subset V x [d] let X = set of vertices occurring in S. Then N(S) = union of N(v) over v in X = N(X), and |S| <= d|X| <= |N(X)| = |N(S)|. Hall's theorem gives f. CLAIM B (edges, uses L and E): let G[K_d] be the lexicographic product (copies (v,i),(v,i') with i!=i' adjacent; (u,j),(v,i) adjacent when uv in E). For f from A, distinct copies of v map to distinct b's both nonzero on I_v, so (L) gives intersecting supports. For uv in E, b_{f(u,j)} is nonzero on I_u and b_{f(v,i)} nonzero on I_v, so (E) gives intersecting supports. f is injective, so no edge maps to a loop. Hence Thm 4.1's conclusion holds with R used only for the injection and L,E only for the edges. SCOPE: general field F, finite spanning families; does NOT cover the colouring kernel spanning family of Thm 5.4 (needs its own check of R, L, E), and says nothing about running time or width (Remark 6.4). NOT P vs NP progress. Independent computational check: cm-416478a2f1f34b2b (3000 random GF(3) trials, 3 blocks of size 2): R-holding instances 626, Hall injection failures 0; non-R instances 2374, of which 457 still admit an injection and 1917 do not (so the test has power); RLE instances 131, edge failures 0.

statement: Setting of S0001: K subset F^I with blocks I_v, B = (b_j)_{j in J} spanning K, N(v) = {j : b_j restricted to I_v nonzero}, N(X) = union of N(v) over v in X. For a finite S subset of V x [d], let X(S) = {v : (v,i) in S for some i} and N(S) = union of N(v) over (v,i) in S. Then (a) N(S) = N(X(S)); (b) if d*|X(S)| <= rank pi_X(K), then |S| <= |N(S)|.
proof: (a) Each (v,i) in S has v in X(S), so N(v) is contained in N(X(S)); hence N(S) is contained in N(X(S)). Conversely each v in X(S) is the first coordinate of some (v,i) in S, so N(v) is contained in N(S). (b) The projection of S lies in X(S) x [d], so |S| <= d*|X(S)|. By the rank bound, d*|X(S)| <= rank pi_X <= |N(X(S))| (rank_step, Lean cm-ddf8f810edf14e09), and by (a) |N(X(S))| = |N(S)|.
scope: Finite families over any field; composes the hypotheses of S0001 Claim A into the cardinality bound |S| <= |N(S)| needed for Hall's condition.
not_progress: Bookkeeping composition of Claim A, not a new obligation closed.

LEMMA (composition of S0001 Claim A and Claim B; conditional on L and E; bookkeeping, not progress). Setting: K subset F^I, blocks I_v (v in V), G=(V,E), d>=1, B=(b_j)_{j in J} a finite indexed family spanning K. Hypotheses: (L) for every v and any x,y in K both nonzero on I_v, supp(x) and supp(y) intersect. (E) for every edge uv in E and any x,y in K with x nonzero on I_u and y nonzero on I_v, supp(x) and supp(y) intersect. Assume an injection f: V x [d] -> J with f(v,i) in N(v) (S0001 Claim A, which uses R and spanning). Define phi(v,i) = b_{f(v,i)}. Claim: for every edge of the lexicographic product G[K_d] (edges (v,i)-(v,i') with i != i', and (u,i)-(v,j) with uv in E), the images phi have intersecting supports, and phi is injective on indices. Proof: (i) same block, i != i': f is injective so the indices differ; both vectors are nonzero on I_v because f(v,.) in N(v); (L) gives intersecting supports. (ii) uv in E: phi(u,i) is nonzero on I_u and phi(v,j) is nonzero on I_v; (E) gives intersecting supports. Since f is injective, no edge maps to a loop. So phi is a graph embedding of G[K_d] into the overlap graph H_B. Scope: any field, finite indexed spanning families (if B has repeated vectors, read it as indexed). Hypotheses L and E are NOT verified here for the colouring kernel K_G(F) (paper Lemma 5.2 / Thm 5.4). No running-time or width claim. Closes no open obligation. This session is claude-haiku-5-5, the same family as S0001 and S0002, so it cannot review them.
